necessary_force_screen.scope:
Add necessary force-cone conditions to the isolated chord-grasp search.

This rejects provably impossible finger-only support in the reconstructed
geometry. Passing is inconclusive, never a grasp-stability or physics success.
No force limit, friction parameter, collision gate or live state is changed.

upward_capacity.meaning: A strictly negative maximum rules out upward support from any nonnegative combination of these finger contact cones. A nonnegative result does not prove stable grasp.

open_approach_screen.scope:
Screen the OPEN approach as well as the final chord-grasp pose.

This experimental chord protocol requires open fingers to clear the target
before closing. The usual teacher intentionally allows finger/target contact;
this extra geometric condition is explicit and is not a new global gate.
It prevents relying on an unchanged plate pose after an intersecting descent.
open_approach_screen.tolerance_scope: Isolated approach geometry diagnostic; not a hardware or production collision limit.

vertical_approach_experiment.scope:
Controlled vertical-approach variant of the plate chord-grasp experiment.

Relative to probe_chord_release.py, only the plate pregrasp approach changes
from tool-axis descent to world-vertical descent. All original physical gates,
geometry, forces, closing, lifting and flat-placement checks remain in effect.
Geometry-only screening is a necessary preflight, not a physical success.
